attributes.board_name: Idaho State Board of Pharmacy (Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses)

rules.alternatives: No fixed hour count: pharmacists are expected to complete sufficient CE germane to pharmacy to maintain competence, and at each renewal attest that they maintained competence through CE commensurate with their active practice setting.
rules.notes: Idaho Code 54-1723C (added 2025) sets no fixed CE hours, only a competence attestation. Renewal cycle not recorded: DOPL is phasing in new renewal cycles for its boards.
